svg.text: 3. Lobby: sides, bots per side, Ready (the same in A, B and C)

g.text: Pick a side. The host sets how many bots fill each side. Everyone Ready starts the Team Lobby.

svg.text: 4. Team Lobby, phase 1: propose and vote

g.text: The Long-Named Hunters of the Frozen Wast…
Dax has not voted. Votes can change until the clock ends or everyone is Ready.
time runs out: a random proposal wins

svg.text: 5. Team Lobby: the vote ends in a tie, the captain picks

g.text: The Long-Named Hunters of the Frozen Wast…
Sunrise Vanguard wins: a three-way tie, so the captain picked it.
time runs out: a random proposal wins

svg.text: 6. Team Lobby, phase 2: claim a character

g.text: Claim a character. First come, first served. The rest are bots.

svg.text: 7. Team Lobby, a side of one player

g.text: You are alone on this side: there is no vote, your proposal stands. The clock only ends the phase early for everyone who is Ready.
Propose nothing, and the house team plays.
